notes:
TCC Website 0.14.4: second batch of the full code audit

- Event lists: every list is picked out of one shared read of The Events
  Calendar (tcc_upcoming_all, pages of 200, at most 2,000); no 150-date limit;
  a category list includes its sub-categories.
- Large files split into parts, each editable on the Features tab: search
  (features/sitewide-search/), Trinity Talk (features/trinity-talk/), Sermons
  (features/sermon-filters/) and the Planning Center screens (admin-tabs,
  admin-buttons, admin-event-box). Code moved verbatim; names unchanged. A broken
  or out-of-date edit of a part makes its feature say "Needs a look".
- Colours named once in features/colours.css (--tcc-teal and 11 more, 313 uses),
  printed as <style id="tcc-colours">; computed colours unchanged.
- Release workflow: lints every PHP file with the runner's PHP and PHP 7.4, and
  runs the Playground tests on PHP 8.3 and 7.4 before building.
- Planning Center: tags read in pages; all-day events compared as The Events
  Calendar saves them (fixes a false conflict); uninstall.php removes only the
  sign-in, temporary data and the search-misses log, keeping events and choices.
- Sermons: a Speaker category is one whole person (commas no longer split it),
  and a card names every Speaker category.
- Every remembered list starts afresh once after an update.
- Tests: 247 pass on PHP 7.4, 8.3 and 8.4 (TCC_PHP=7.4 tests/playground/run.sh).
  An independent review found nothing that breaks the site; its three minor
  findings are fixed. Test build checked on staging.
- AI notes: version history removed, notes for every part and colours.css.
